name: Khaleeji UAE VAT Invoices for WooCommerce
author: nadeemfarooqi

sections.description:
Every VAT-registered business in the United Arab Emirates must give its customers a tax invoice. WooCommerce does not create one.

Khaleeji UAE VAT Invoices for WooCommerce creates the tax invoice for each order as a PDF in Arabic and English, with the details the UAE VAT Executive Regulation asks for, and creates a tax credit note automatically when you refund an order.

Tax invoice

  • Titled “Tax Invoice” and “فاتورة ضريبية”.
  • Your legal name, address and TRN, in English and Arabic.
  • The customer’s name and address, and their TRN when they are a VAT-registered business.
  • A sequential invoice number that is never reused, the date of issue and the date of supply.
  • For every line: quantity, unit price, discount, taxable amount, VAT rate, VAT amount and total.
  • Total discount, total excluding VAT, total VAT and the amount payable, in AED.
  • Sell in another currency? The invoice also shows the AED amounts and the exchange rate you set.
  • Arabic letters join correctly and read right to left. Choose Arabic and English, English only, or Arabic only.

Tax credit note

  • Made automatically when you refund an invoiced order, in full or in part. Free, not a paid add-on.
  • Titled “Tax Credit Note” and “إشعار دائن ضريبي”, with its own number series.
  • Shows the original invoice, the reason for the refund, the original value, the corrected value, the difference and the VAT on the difference.

For you and your customers

  • The invoice is issued when an order is Completed (or Processing, if you prefer), or by hand with one click on the order screen.
  • The PDF is attached to the customer’s order and refund emails.
  • Customers can download their invoices from My Account and the order confirmation page.
  • An issued invoice never changes: the details are saved on the order when it is issued.
  • Optional “Company TRN” field at checkout for business buyers (off by default). Arabic digits are accepted.
  • Works with the classic checkout and the Cart & Checkout blocks, and with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • AI agents and automation can read and issue invoices through the WordPress Abilities API.

Privacy and security

Invoices are made on your own site. The plugin sends nothing to any outside service, needs no account or API key, and does not track anything. PDFs are not kept as files: each one is made when it is opened (email copies are deleted as soon as the email is sent), and only shop managers, the customer who placed the order, or someone with the order’s private link can open it.

Credits

PDFs are made with mPDF (GPLv2, https://mpdf.github.io), included with its namespaces prefixed so it cannot clash with other plugins. The Arabic and English text uses IBM Plex Sans Arabic (SIL Open Font License 1.1, copyright IBM Corp.), included unmodified in assets/fonts with its licence.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install this plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the zip file, and activate it.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > VAT Invoices and enter your 15-digit TRN, your legal name and address in English and Arabic.

Invoices start with the next order that is Completed. To continue the numbering from another system, set the next invoice number in the settings.
sections.faq:
Is this enough for UAE e-invoicing?

No. From 1 July 2027 most VAT-registered businesses must send business-to-business invoices as e-invoices through an Accredited Service Provider (from 1 January 2027 for businesses with revenue of AED 50 million or more). Sales to consumers are not part of e-invoicing yet, so PDF tax invoices stay valid for them. This plugin makes PDF tax invoices and credit notes. Check your own obligations with your tax adviser.

Does the invoice have to be in Arabic?

English is accepted on tax invoices. The Federal Tax Authority can ask for an Arabic translation of any document, so many businesses prefer Arabic and English on one invoice. You can choose either.

What happens if I cancel an order that already has an invoice?

Refund it in WooCommerce (Refund button on the order screen, or set the status to Refunded). A tax credit note is created for the refund.

Can I change the invoice numbers?

You can move the next number forward, for example to continue from your old system. Numbers never go back and are never reused, even if you uninstall and reinstall the plugin.

Why is no invoice created for my orders?

The plugin waits until your 15-digit TRN is set, because a tax invoice without the supplier’s TRN is not valid. Invoices are created when an order becomes Completed (or Processing, if you chose that), not for orders that were completed before.

Can I change the layout?

Copy templates/document.php from the plugin to yourtheme/khaleeji-uae-vat-invoices/document.php and edit the copy. Developers can also use the uaevi_document_number, uaevi_exchange_rate, uaevi_buyer_trn and uaevi_should_issue_invoice filters.

What happens to my invoices if I delete the plugin?

Your settings are removed, but issued invoices and credit notes stay on the orders, because they are tax records that must be kept for five years. The number counters are also kept, so numbers never restart.
